articles.title: How to make a payment voucher
articles.summary: Make a payment voucher in Nivesh Sahayak for money you pay: mode, payee, particulars and account head, TDS and PAN, reverse charge, prepared and approved by.

articles.title: How payment voucher numbers work

articles.title: Print, PDF and share a payment voucher

articles.title: Saved payment vouchers: find, open, copy and edit
articles.card: Saved payment vouchers: open, copy, edit
articles.summary: Find any saved payment voucher in Nivesh Sahayak: search the Saved payment vouchers list, open to edit or reprint, copy it as new, set its status.
